message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**What the 10-K showed (FY ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024):**
- Total net sales: $391,035M, up 2% from $383,285M
- Gross margin: $180,683M (46.2% of sales, up from 44.1%)
- Operating income: $123,216M, up from $114,301M
- **Net income: $93,736M** (down from $96,995M) — the decline was driven by a one-time, non-operating $10.2B net income tax charge tied to the EC State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7%); pre-tax income actually rose to $123,485M
- Diluted EPS: $6.08; operating cash flow: $118,254M; cash + marketable securities: $140.8B
- Services revenue grew 13% to $96,169M at a 73.9% gross margin, offsetting flat iPhone sales and an 8% decline in Greater China

**Order placed:** Buy 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.75 (quote was $222.68 bid / $222.72 ask, so the limit was essentially at market). Filled at $222.75 for a total of $9,801.00 — within the $10,000 per-order cap, the only order today (well under the $20,000 daily cap), a buy in a permitted name, and funded entirely from existing cash ($50,000 available), so no money left the account.

**Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K and concluded the business remains fundamentally strong despite a headline net income decline: revenue rose 2% to $391.0B, gross margin expanded to 46.2%, and operating income grew 8.7% to $123.2B, with the drop in net income to $93.7B (from $97.0B) attributable to a one-time $10.2B net tax charge from the EU State Aid ruling rather than any deterioration in operations — operating cash flow of $118.3B and $140.8B in cash and marketable securities confirm the underlying earnings power, while the 13% growth in high-margin Services (73.9% gross margin) offsets hardware softness and Greater China weakness. Based on that, I bought 44 shares of AAPL at a $222.75 limit (fill $222.75, ~$9,801 total), sized to stay under the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily limits and paid from existing cash, with the key figure relied upon being Apple's fiscal 2024 net income of $93,736 million.
